Name: Early Town Shortcuts
Author: NoraCharles
Description:
I like the town shortcuts, but I hate how long it takes to unlock them. This mod makes the shortcuts available immediately!

Each shortcut can be individually enabled/disabled in config.json or GMCM.

If you're not familiar with the town shortcuts, you can read about them on the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Carpenter%27s_Shop#Community_Upgrades]wiki[/url].

NOTE: There is a minor visual glitch on one of the shortcuts "Mountain/Town Right" -- on the mountain side, a few tiles have a misplaced white water line animation (visible in the screenshot above). I tested without mods and found that this is actually a vanilla game bug, so I've reported it.

I recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7911]Horse Overhaul[/url] so that you can ride your horse through all of the shortcuts.

If you like this mod, check out my mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20853]Map Tweaks for 1.6[/url]﻿ which adds some extra bridges and staircases as well as other convenient features!


[b]REQUIREMENTS & COMPATIBILITY[/b]

[list]
[*]Only for Stardew 1.6
[*]Requires Content Patcher
[*]Should be compatible with mods that patch the vanilla maps, e.g. to add a custom NPC's house or an entrance to a new custom map.
[*]Probably not compatible with mods that overhaul the vanilla maps, such as SVE.
[/list][b]
INSTRUCTIONS FOR EXISTING SAVES[/b]

If this mod is installed on an existing save, there will be bushes blocking 2 of the shortcuts. You can use [url=https://github.com/Lake1059/ResetTerrainFeatures_NET6]ResetTerrainFeatures_NET6[/url]﻿ to reset the bushes on the [b]Backwoods[/b] and [b]Forest[/b] maps if you are using those shortcuts. (See last screenshot above)

You will also need to reset the bushes if you decide later to disable (or re-enable) those config options.


[b]OTHER MODS SHOWN IN SCREENSHOTS[/b]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url]﻿ plus [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20698]VPR Temporary Fix for 1.6[/url]


[b]MY OTHER MODS[/b]

Check out [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/NoraCharles/mods?gameId=1303]my other mods for Stardew Valley[/url], which include maps, animals, crops, furniture, clothing, and more!
All donation points earned by my mods go to [url=https://www.doctorswithoutborders.org/]Doctors Without Borders[/url].
